title: EU threatens Meta with fines over 'addictive' Facebook and Instagram

facts.claim: The European Commission issued preliminary findings threatening to fine Meta up to 6% of its total global annual turnover if it does not change the design of Facebook and Instagram to reduce compulsive use.
facts.subject: Meta
facts.magnitude: up to 6% of total global annual turnover
facts.cause: Meta failed to adequately assess risks from infinite scroll, autoplaying videos, and personalized recommendations that encourage compulsive use and excessive time spent on platforms, particularly among children and teens

facts.subject: Petrol
facts.cause: The conflict in the Middle East caused elevated prices that have persisted despite oil returning to pre-war pricing levels

facts.claim: Petrol prices vary by more than 11 pence per litre between forecourts less than three miles apart in Hull, with retailers buying oil at different times and local competition affecting costs.
facts.subject: Petrol
facts.magnitude: 11p per litre difference between nearby forecourts
facts.cause: Retailers purchasing oil at different times (bulk advance versus daily spot price), local competition levels, and location overheads for remote sites
